etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle French éruption, from Latin eruptio.

definitions.definition: A violent ejection, such as the spurting out of lava from a volcano.
A sudden release of pressure or tension.
An utterance, especially a sudden one; an ejaculation.

quote.citation: 1976 December 18, Rudy Kikel, “The Doomsday Book by the Jewish Comedian”, in Gay Community News, volume 4, number 25, page 15:
quote.text: Ultimately, Greenfield may remind us of no one so much as Boston's own, Sylvia Sidney — "herself" in the amusement business! From whom else does one expect so leveling a sequence of eruptions: "i mean yah gotta win a little money/ i mean we're all whores turning a trick"?

definitions.definition: An infection of the skin resulting in a rash or blemishing.
